summary: VivoPower PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing that Adam Traidman is concluding his role as Chairman of the Board of Advisors, effective July 17, 2026. Traidman joined in May 2025 to advise on digital assets and blockchain strategy, but the company's focus has shifted to powered land and data center digital infrastructure. His departure is described as mutual and not due to any disagreement. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed. This is a non-routine advisory board departure tied to strategic pivot, not a routine meeting notice. Watch for further advisory board appointments and updates on Tembo subsidiary business combination.
